cards.label: Per position
cards.text: Record fiber, battery, or mains for the body you are on. Lit rack converters do not prove fiber power at the camera.

steps: Identity photo. Photograph the side-plate model name with Head of Video clearance.

Back focus. Run the house back-focus guide before the show.
